modification_check.primary_source_statement: Primary Table 1 lists peptide sequences and methods state peptides were purchased; terminal free-modification labels are database-only and not independently confirmed in source text.

record_audits.conflict_context: Primary paper source verifies this peptide name/sequence in Table 1 and supports anticancer/antitumor activity for this peptide family, but DRAMP labels the activity as both Antimicrobial and Anticancer.
